Accounting Assistant, Co-op

Company: Thornbury Mills
Location: Hamilton, ON
Work Arrangement: On-site
Work Term: Winter 2028
Duration: 4 months
Application Deadline: October 9, 2027

About the Role

Thornbury Mills is a family-owned textile manufacturer. The Accounting Assistant will
support the general ledger close and accounts payable processing.

Responsibilities

- Prepare accounts payable batches and vendor reconciliations
- Assist with month-end general ledger close
- Support audit documentation requests

Qualifications

- Enrolled in an accounting or business program
- Working knowledge of Excel

Compensation is discussed during the interview process.
